//: Decodable/Encodable impls of external types for the derive(Decodable)/(Encodable) generator (tools/codegen/types.ts,
sets with derive_decodable / derive_encodable). paths: resolved Rust paths (bare names match prelude/std/core/alloc).
decode: call template ($D the decoder, $d0..$dn Decodable fns of the type arguments); encode: call template ($v the
value, $E the encoder, $e0..$en Encodable fns of the type arguments). Their decode_*/encode_* names are imported from
`import` (default: `module`), plus `values` (from `values_import`, default `import`). transparent: the type argument's impl (Box/Rc/Arc/Cell/RefCell/Lrc).
*_nullable: Option of an undefined-able type ({ $: "Some", _0 } | undefined, PORTING section 5).
Types of the set itself (derived, manual impl exported by the hand module, newtype_index! #[encodable]) need no entry.
decoders / encoders: the TS type of each derive's decoder (`__D: SpanDecoder` for derive(Decodable), ...). rustc_span's
SpanDecoder / BlobDecoder are ported (src/rustc_span/lib.ts); the rustc_middle / rustc_metadata decoder traits are not yet:
until they are, those derives take the plain rustc_serialize Decoder; switch the entry (and regenerate) when the trait exists.
encoders mirror decoders (plan-m5 D3): `Encodable` takes a SpanEncoder, `TyEncodable` a TyEncoder, `MetadataEncodable` the EncodeContext;
a generic type's encode_<T> is generic over the encoder (`__E extends SpanEncoder`), like rustc_serialize's encode_Vec<T, S>.
TyDecoder impls (lane rmeta-ty): `I::X` names TyCtxt's associated type (impl_interner.rs). An entry keyed by an item of a set
`GenericArgsRef`, ...) gives the Decodable impl of a type whose impl lives outside its own module (rustc_middle ty/codec.rs,
rustc_type_ir serialize.rs) when the set does not generate its derive; it takes precedence over the item's hand module.
